scope: 20 remaining original tasks in the frozen 40-task roster; one fresh solver context per task
solver_context: fork_turns=none; original prompt and references only; no project rubrics, source-audit interpretations, prior outputs, human labels or reference answers
execution_route: in-app delegated solver and judge contexts
external_evidence_policy: Primary sources preferred; record URL, retrieval date, publication or as-of date, supported claim and captured evidence. Respect historical cutoffs. No benchmark answer lookup. No messages, filings, purchases or publication.
builder_policy: Logged solver-authored local builders and native artifact registration; source inputs read-only; code, errors, revisions, hashes, native-feature audits and render inspection retained
source_isolation: Instruction-enforced path allowlist in shared filesystem; not OS isolation
run_limit: One fresh context per original task, with self-inspection revisions before first submission; no standardized API token/turn limit
cost_note: No new OpenRouter inference calls. All existing unresolved-charge reservations retained. App usage may consume subscription allowance; its dollar cost is unavailable, not zero.
grading: Frozen project requirements; stated-versus-operative checks, source/output evidence, severity, uncertainty and native behavior checks. Author-hidden independent requested judge context, same OpenAI family. Contract validation is not accuracy validation.
comparability: Keep v2 API, v3 in-app and v4 in-app/code/web cohorts separate. Forty is a unique original-task inventory, not forty identical-condition experiments. No model ranking or Artificial Analysis Elo claim.
